query:
SELECT al.id,
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                THEN NULL::uuid
                ELSE al.user_id
            END AS "user_id?",
            al.action, al.entity_type, al.entity_id,
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                     AND jsonb_typeof(al.old_values) = 'object'
                THEN al.old_values - ARRAY[
                    'processed_by', 'submitted_by', 'approved_by',
                    'locked_by', 'cancelled_by', 'created_by', 'updated_by'
                ]::text[]
                ELSE al.old_values
            END AS "old_values?",
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                     AND jsonb_typeof(al.new_values) = 'object'
                THEN al.new_values - ARRAY[
                    'processed_by', 'submitted_by', 'approved_by',
                    'locked_by', 'cancelled_by', 'created_by', 'updated_by'
                ]::text[]
                ELSE al.new_values
            END AS "new_values?",
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                THEN NULL::text
                ELSE al.ip_address
            END AS "ip_address?",
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                THEN NULL::text
                ELSE al.user_agent
            END AS "user_agent?",
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                THEN NULL::text
                ELSE al.description
            END AS "description?",
            al.created_at,
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                THEN NULL::text
                ELSE u.email
            END AS "user_email?",
            CASE
                WHEN $3::bool AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.roles && ARRAY['admin', 'super_admin']::varchar[]
                THEN NULL::text
                ELSE u.full_name
            END AS "user_full_name?"
        FROM audit_logs al
        LEFT JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id
        WHERE al.company_id = $1
          AND (
            (al.entity_type = 'payroll_run' AND al.entity_id = $2)
            OR (
                al.entity_type = 'payroll_item'
                AND (
                    al.old_values->>'payroll_run_id' = $2::text
                    OR al.new_values->>'payroll_run_id' = $2::text
                )
            )
          )
        ORDER BY al.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 100
